title: Save the credit explanation arrays
description: You inspect the data bundled into the example's NumPy archive.

steps.description: You create the artifacts directory if needed and begin one NumPy archive. Its first entries hold feature names and the standardization parameters mu and sig.
You include both layers' weights and biases alongside the background samples. These entries preserve the model parameters and explanation background.

steps.question: Which saved entries let you connect the batch attributions to their sampled rows?
steps.answer: Phi stores the batch attributions, and subset_idx stores subset. The archive also includes global_importance.

steps.description: You also save x0, phi, the baseline value, and fx. The recorded directory listing contains credit_shap_from_scratch.npz.
